jobs.title: Digital Project Manager
jobs.description:
Location:
Minneapolis, MN

Hires local to the Twin Cities Metro-Area can anticipate an in-office component of 1-2 days a week, employed with Bold Orange. If this position lists, “Open to Remote”, hires outside of the metro area can anticipate travel to our Minneapolis, MN office on an as-requested basis. We value human connection and some travel is anticipated.

About Bold Orange:

Bold Orange (BOCO) is a customer experience company. We believe authentic human connections are the single most important driver of business and societal progress. We exist to create these connections across the customer lifecycle, from acquisition to engagement to retention. Our culture is one of curiosity, collaboration, proactivity and always bringing the outside, future focused perspective to our clients.

Position Summary:

Project Management is a key part of the Bold Orange success story. By supporting key efforts for a variety of clients, our stellar PM's have a direct impact on the success of client relationships and project deliverables. We are seeking an ambitious, detail-oriented Digital Project Manager qualified and eager to execute digital strategies and campaigns by working collaboratively with teams and subject matter experts to plan, organize, coordinate, and manage projects and retainers across all channels.

The ideal candidate thrives in an environment where there is high level strategic thinking, a client service focus, a culture of affirmation, and the desire to support and lead with strong agile project management skills on a wide variety of accounts.

Position Duties and Responsibilities:

Partnership and potential full project ownership and implementation from initiation to delivery for multiple simultaneous digital initiatives such as website development, marketing automation, personalization, technical implementations, etc
Define scope, build, and manage budgets, and outline resource plans to align appropriate talent to the project
Create and drive sprint plans and timelines to ensure that key project milestones are met
Foster the Bold Orange culture, and guide the team to apply Bold Orange principles in their work
Conduct stand ups and status meetings internally and with clients regarding project deliverables and requirements
Continuously find ways to optimize workflow and efficiencies, maximizing the team’s effectiveness
Inform, support, collaborate and motivate team members to meet project goals and milestones

Required Qualifications & Experience:

3-7 years of project management experience from a digital marketing agency environment
Previous experience managing evolving initiatives and multi-channel marketing campaigns that may include: overall customer experience strategy, marketing automation, email marketing, web design and development, management, digital marketing campaigns, SEO, analytics, etc
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
Ambitious, detail oriented, hard-working, proactive, hands-on demeanor
Strong organizational skills
Ability and desire to work directly with clients
Ability to thrive in a fast-paced work environment that will require you to re-prioritize and creatively problem solve through change often
Continued professional development in order to keep abreast of emerging technologies, methods and best practices

Benefits That Matter:

Our benefits are designed to support life’s many stages—expected and unexpected. Eligible employees can access:

Medical, dental, and vision insurance
Virtual mental health support
Health Savings and Flexible Spending Accounts (including dependent care)
Infertility and critical illness benefits
401(k) with generous 6-10% employer contribution
Paid parental leave
Tuition reimbursement
Free parking and commuter support

Note: Some benefits apply only to full-time employees.

Who We Are:

Our tone is professionally sassy. We embrace meat raffles, hot seats, and the occasional Jell-O shot. We like staff meetings that are informative, educational, and at times, damn funny. We believe in no hierarchy, no bullshit, no politics. Just honest, hard work and great fun.

Important to note:
While we value AI as a tool, AI is not invited to Bold Orange interviews. We want to meet the wonderfully talented human you! Any suspected use of AI to inform or assist, while actively in an interview with Bold Orange, will result in exclusion from consideration for the role to which you applied or were referred.

Equal Opportunity Employer:

We are an equal opportunity employer, dedicated to a policy of nondiscrimination in employment on any basis including race, color, creed, gender, sexual orientation, age, disability, religion, national origin, marital status, familial status, ancestry, status as a veteran, status with regard to public assistance and any other characteristic protected by law. Bold Orange does not and will not discriminate against employees, prospective employees, clients, or vendors.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

We benchmark salaries across industry standards and local markets to ensure we offer competitive, fair compensation. Final offers reflect a candidate’s skills, experience, and location. The annual base for this position is anticipated to be between $65K to $90K. Final compensation will be dependent on the ideal candidate’s experience and local market at the time of hire.

:

Develops and tracks sales, sales leads, and promotes department services. Interacts with other departments to promote cooperative sales and production efforts.
Estimates job costs and presents all proposals to be submitted for review.
Performs the management of projects to meet targeted schedules and costs. Ensures rapid project close-out and turnover.

Oversees and directs efforts related to field production and quality control of installed products.
Oversees and directs efforts related to shop fabrication and quality control of fabricated products.
Assists in developing long-term plans for continued growth of the department.
Purchases materials and utilizes competent inventory analysis and inventory control.
Completes billings, approves invoices, material slips, and coordinates with the payroll department in overseeing payroll/timecards for respective projects.
Resolves disputes with clients and past due accounts efficiently.
Reports all issues which are or may be detrimental to the well-being of the company.
Maintains, institutes, and protects all company equipment, vehicles and personnel policies.
Tracks and controls labor and material costs of jobs.
Set up individual projects.
Invoice contract and time and material projects.
Works with prime and subcontractors on all phases of projects including schedules, change orders, submittals, quality control, etc.
Oversees day to day production maximizing daily revenues.
Directs customer relation efforts related to field personnel.
Reviews purchase orders, contracts, and proposals to verify that they do not compromise company policy or exceed intended scope of work.
Fields customer requests, questions and complaints to the appropriate department.
Other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

Education/Experience
:

Bachelor’s Degree in Business, Construction Management or related field; three plus years related experience is preferred. Experience specifically dealing in architectural sheet metal, commercial wall cladding is highly preferred. Other experience in commercial glazing/curtainwall, building envelopes is also preferred.

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

Ability to read and comprehend complex instructions, business correspondence, and memos. Capability to write correspondence, effectively present information in one-on-one, or group presentations to customers, vendors and/or subcontractors and other employees of the organization.
Calculate figures and amounts such as discounts, interest, aptitude to apply concepts of basic algebra and geometry.
Ability to visualize and articulate 2-dimensional as well as 3-dimensional concepts and building constructability.
Ability to apply common sense understanding to carry out instructions furnished in written, oral, or diagram form. Deal with problems involving several concrete variables in standardized situations.
To perform this job successfully, an individual should have knowledge of Project Estimating software, Microsoft Excel, Access, and Word.
Strong interpersonal skills; oral and written communication skills. Valid Driver’s license and clean driving record.
Must not be afraid of heights and must be able to position extension ladder to access roof for roof inspection/survey.

Life Insurance

At Remitly, we believe everyone deserves the freedom to access, move, and manage their money wherever life takes them. Since 2011, we've tirelessly delivered on our promise to customers sending money globally, providing secure, simple, and reliable ways to manage their money, ensuring true peace of mind. Whether it's supporting loved ones back home, growing a business across continents, or pursuing new opportunities abroad, we're not just here to move money— we're here to move our global customers forward.

We're looking for builders, reimaginers, and global thinkers who want to work at the intersection of technology, trust, and transformation. If that's you and you're ready to do the most meaningful work of your career—we invite you to join over 2,800 passionate Remitlians worldwide who are united by our vision to transform lives with trusted financial services that transcend borders.

About the Role:

Remitly is seeking a Program Manager, Sanctions Compliance to serve as a subject matter and program expert within the Sanctions Compliance Program, exercising a high degree of independent regulatory judgment on the program's most complex and consequential matters. This role sits at the intersection of deep sanctions expertise, complex project execution, and cross-functional influence — owning a number of workstreams across the program's preventive and detective, and corrective workstreams. The person will work closely with Legal, Product Compliance, Identity & Trust, regional compliance leads, and Operations, and their work will regularly inform materials reviewed by senior leadership, banking partners, and regulators.

You Will:
Issue Remediation & Complex Project Management Audit & Controls Testing Management Sanctions Alert Adjudication & Escalation Management Policy, Procedure & Training Governance Controls Intake, I&T Liaison & Jira Governance Sanctions Controls Library Metrics, Reporting & Governance Regulatory Intelligence & SME Support

Act as a subject matter authority and primary escalation point for sanctions queries across Remitly's global teams, resolving matters requiring expert-level regulatory interpretation.
Translate program strategy into structured workplans with defined milestones and owners, driving them to completion and proactively surfacing risks to delivery.
Prepare executive-facing briefing materials enabling the program's status and risk posture to be represented to senior leadership, the board, banking partners, and regulators with precision.
Stand in credibly for the Global Head of Sanctions in working-level meetings.
Own execution of corrective actions from regulatory inquiries, audits, and self-identified gaps, building structured remediation plans and tracking them to closure.
Lead complex, time-sensitive remediation projects, maintaining clear audit trails of methodology and disposition.

Identify sanctions control requirements from new products, corridor expansions, and regulatory developments with regional compliance leads and Product Compliance.

Independently assess implications of new regulations, general licenses, and enforcement actions for Remitly's screening architecture and controls.

About the Opportunity

The Senior Healthcare Data Analyst is a full-time, senior individual contributor responsible for clinical, outcomes, and program analytics across the organization. Based in the United States, this role partners with clinical, operational, and executive leaders to turn complex questions into clear, meaningful insights.

The position requires an understanding of behavioral health care delivery across the patient journey, including referral, intake, admission, treatment, utilization, outcomes, and discharge. Additionally, this role helps advance AI-enabled analytical methods within the data analysis function, utilizing AI to enhance analytical speed, depth, and efficiency while establishing repeatable processes, independently validating outputs, and ensuring clinical and human oversight.

Key Responsibilities

Analyze access, conversion, census, capacity, utilization, length of stay, patient engagement, clinical outcomes, and program performance.
Develop an understanding of behavioral health care delivery, including intake, treatment planning, group, individual, and family therapy, psychiatry, documentation, authorization, outcomes, and discharge.
Partner with clinical and operational leaders to translate clinical workflows and complex operational questions into meaningful analyses, recommendations, and actionable insights.
Ensure analytical findings reflect actual care delivery workflows and are interpreted within appropriate clinical and operational contexts.
Identify trends, patterns, risks, and opportunities to improve care delivery, patient experience, and program performance.
Partner with clinical and research leaders to define research questions, outcome measures, analytical approaches, and data requirements for clinical studies and program evaluations.
Build accurate, well-documented, and reproducible datasets and analyses for outcomes research, program evaluations, presentations, abstracts, and publications.
Conduct and interpret analyses evaluating patient outcomes, treatment and program effectiveness, and differences across populations, programs, or levels of care.
Translate findings into publication-ready tables, visualizations, summaries, and presentation materials, supporting analytical review through final publication.
Ensure research and publication data and analyses comply with organizational privacy, governance, compliance, and data-use standards.
Serve as an analytics partner to clinical, operational, and executive leadership, establishing and maintaining trusted metric definitions, documentation, analytical standards, and best practices.
Partner with Data Engineering and other analysts to maintain consistent definitions, reliable data, scalable solutions, and standardized dashboards or reporting workflows.
Identify opportunities to improve analytical methods, tools, workflows, and organizational data use while mentoring other analysts.
Apply and advance AI-enabled analytical methods to improve the speed, depth, quality, and efficiency of analytical workflows.
Use AI tools to accelerate data exploration, analytical development, synthesis, and quality review, establishing repeatable prompts, workflows, and standards.
Independently validate AI-generated outputs for accuracy, relevance, bias, and context, maintaining human accountability for all final analytical conclusions.
Collaborate with clinical subject matter experts and technology teams to evaluate AI capabilities and integrate them into governed analytical workflows.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Analytics, Statistics, Information Systems, Healthcare Administration, Health Informatics, Public Health, or a relevant clinical discipline (such as Psychology, Social Work, Counseling, or Nursing), or equivalent relevant experience.
5+ years of experience in analytics, healthcare analytics, business intelligence, or related analytical work. Candidates with a clinical background must also have demonstrated experience using data to evaluate care delivery, patient outcomes, program performance, or other complex healthcare questions.
Experience working with healthcare clinical operations and translating clinical workflows and business questions into meaningful analysis.
Experience analyzing healthcare performance metrics, including access, utilization, quality, outcomes, or program effectiveness.
Experience with modern analytics and business intelligence platforms, such as Power BI.
Strong analytical skills with the ability to independently investigate complex clinical and operational questions.
Demonstrated ability to translate complex data into clear insights for clinical, operational, and executive audiences.
Experience using AI or generative AI to support analytical work, with an understanding of how to validate outputs and manage the risks and limitations of AI-generated analysis.
Strong communication, prioritization, facilitation, and stakeholder partnership skills.
Understanding of healthcare privacy, security, compliance, and the proper handling of protected health information (PHI).

Experience in behavioral health, intensive outpatient programs (IOP), partial hospitalization programs (PHP), outpatient mental health, substance use treatment, or similar clinical environments.
Familiarity with behavioral health workflows, including intake, treatment planning, therapy, psychiatry, documentation, utilization management, outcomes measurement, and discharge.
Experience with clinical outcomes, program evaluation, or research-related analytics.
Experience working with electronic health records (EHR/EMR) and healthcare operational systems.
Experience incorporating AI-assisted methods into analytical workflows or working with modern cloud data and analytics platforms, such as Microsoft Fabric.

About the Opportunity

The Senior Healthcare Data Analyst is a full-time, senior individual contributor responsible for clinical, outcomes, and program analytics across the organization. Based in the United States, this role partners with clinical, operational, and executive leaders to turn complex questions into clear, meaningful insights.

The position requires an understanding of behavioral health care delivery across the patient journey, including referral, intake, admission, treatment, utilization, outcomes, and discharge. Additionally, this role helps advance AI-enabled analytical methods within the data analysis function, utilizing AI to enhance analytical speed, depth, and efficiency while establishing repeatable processes, independently validating outputs, and ensuring clinical and human oversight.

Key Responsibilities

Analyze access, conversion, census, capacity, utilization, length of stay, patient engagement, clinical outcomes, and program performance.
Develop an understanding of behavioral health care delivery, including intake, treatment planning, group, individual, and family therapy, psychiatry, documentation, authorization, outcomes, and discharge.

Work within Agile (Scrum) and Waterfall project methodologies, using tools such as JIRA, Confluence, HP ALM or TestRail to manage requirements, sprints and defects.

Bachelors degree in Information Systems, Business, Computer Science or related field, or equivalent practical experience.
5+ years of hands-on ERP business analysis experience, with strong experience specifically on Syteline (Infor CloudSuite Industrial) implementations preferred.
Proven expertise in requirements gathering, business process analysis, gap analysis, functional specifications, user stories, BRDs and test case creation.
Experience with data migration, ETL, data mapping, master data management and SQL (PL/SQL, T-SQL) for data validation and reporting.
Familiarity with integrations and middleware (APIs, REST, SOAP, EDI, MuleSoft, Dell Boomi, Informatica, Tibco or similar) and experience coordinating integration testing.
